title: Medieval Manor
author: Haman24
selftext:
I love the layout of this model, especially the walking space inside the estate. Let me know what you think and what kind of building would you like to see next?

Made with RapidAssets

replies.author: Haman24
replies.body: Since it's for background purposes, it does not include interior modeling
